short: 3D DenseNet regressor (M06) and LJ-Speech WaveNet (M08) are standard: no in-paper baseline, mixed later head-to-heads, and no listener test behind the quality claims.
position: The paper changes the neural-to-spectrogram regressor (M06), a per-participant 3D DenseNet over the ECoG grid and time, and the waveform generator (M08), a WaveNet trained on the single-speaker LJ-Speech corpus [@angrick2019speech]. Both are standard. No simpler regressor is trained on the same folds, and [later] head-to-head tests are mixed and none reruns the target's configuration: a recurrent encoder-decoder beat a DenseNet fed raw sEEG [@kohler2022synthesizing], a re-tuned DenseNet led a sequence model on HD ECoG significantly but marginally in size [@berezutskaya2023direct], and a 3D-CNN trailed a fully connected network on sEEG [@arthur2024speech]. The evaluation (M12) has a strong retrained shuffle null but no listener or identification test, so the quality claims are assertions; the [concurrent] sentence-level system [@anumanchipalli2019speech] backed its claim with listener transcription.
